verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies. Hands-on probes show it does not deliver: www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt returns HTTP 403 with an Akamai "Access Denied" marker, and webapp.ftb.ca.gov returns 404 for robots.txt. No readable robots policy exists for an agent to consult before fetching.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
